main_text.p: delectatus recedat, & fideliter monitus ad reliqua quoq; perlegenda reuertatur.
De turdis inter autores non conuenit. Turdi.

p.i: Nil melius turdo, vulua nil dulcius ampla,
Inter aues turdus si quis me iudice certet,

main_text.p: inque eam venerunt sententiam, vt veteres tanquā rei alimentariæ indoctos damnârint.

Sed & illud non parua admiratione di-gnum est, quod Gal.3. de alim. facult. scripsit, turdos & passerculos, perdicibus, attagenis, columbis, gallis, phasianis & gallinis concoctu esse duriores, & posset hunc locum men-do scatere[?] quis suspicari, nisi eadem verba Oribasii & Aëtii notata haberétur.

Cur autem in admirationem hoc veniat, po-N. Ma- tissimum in causa est, quod idem 7. methodi gus nutri- & alibi scriptum reliquit, quæcunque magis entia dif- nutriunt, difficilius à calore naturali confici. ficilius à Vnde si turdis & passerib. perdices, gallinæ, & calore ve-calore ve- phasiani magis nutriunt, funtq;, vt loquitur triculi cōtriculi cō Celsus, firmioris materiæ, par quoq; est diffi-ficienda cili? concoq. At ver o phasianos, quo, quātu funt.fint. ad coctionis nutriendiq; vim attinet, gallinis Phasiani pares, edendi vero suauitate superiores facit folis va-porib. à culinarum effectis magi-poribus ... trifq; maiore ob gulæ iucunditate coq cosue-coeli.
{*} D. Hier. testis est, in epist. n. ad Ocean. §3.

page.notes: The leading mark of the footnote, "D.", is doubtful and may be a symbol. "N. Ma-" in the margin is doubtful. "pfectis" and "quātu funt" (or "fint") are doubtful readings. "Gal.3." is doubtful. The first verse line has "Nil" and the lines in italic may differ slightly in spelling. The line "folis va-porib." is doubtful as main text or margin. The line "trifq; maiore ob gulæ" is partly illegible and may need correction. The page is printed PROROGANDA. as the running head.
